title: SEC0: review complete, 2 bugs filed
description: Reviewed all 5 files (harness.rs, e2e.rs, kithd/src/lib.rs:215-280, kith-peer/src/lib.rs:395-480, kithd/src/tls.rs). Two correctness bugs filed as KITH-0z7.5 and KITH-0z7.8. No other correctness issues found. Specifically verified: (1) DeliveryState::Received is correctly used for bob's inbound messages; (2) PinnedCertVerifier does real TLS signature verification (delegates to platform provider) and byte-equality pinning is the correct approach; (3) now_unix in full_message_delivery is obtained after Message/set completes, guaranteeing it is >= the enqueue timestamp so get_due always returns the row; (4) offline_delivery_and_retry far-future now2=1_000_000_000 correctly bypasses backoff; (5) auth rejection test correctly uses state-counter as independent oracle; (6) contact pre-population is symmetric (alice knows bob and bob knows alice); (7) no race conditions in TCP listener setup (bind happens before tokio::spawn); (8) self-certifying chat_id (KITH-0z7.5) and pid-only temp dir (KITH-0z7.8) are the real bugs.
